subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP Draft & Timeline Options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@zenwell.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@zenwell.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Redwood MAP Draft & Timeline Options

Hi Daniel / Aisha \u0014

Thanks again for your time today. Really appreciated the detailed run-through of Zenwell's inference needs and the constraints around PHI handling and deployment timing. Per our discussion, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to get alignment on milestones, owners, and a couple of timeline options.

High-level summary (see attached for full table):
- Milestone 1 \u0014 Prod-ready POC environment (customer-facing inference)
  - Owner: Zenwell (implementation lead) + Redwood (SE + infra)
  - Target: Option A: 6 weeks; Option B: 10 weeks (depends on SSO/KMS integration)
  - Dependencies: SSO config, data access approval, SOC 2 evidence exchange

- Milestone 2 \u0014 Security & compliance sign-off (SOC 2 + data handling checklist)
  - Owner: Zenwell procurement/security + Redwood security
  - Target: 2-3 weeks after evidence exchange
  - Dependencies: completed questionnaire, legal review of DPA

- Milestone 3 \u0014 Pilot run / performance validation (RPS, latency, cost targets)
  - Owner: Redwood (ops) + Zenwell (product)
  - Target: 2 weeks after environment ready

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm the internal stakeholders you'd like included on the MAP (I included Aisha and Procurement as placeholders).
2) Pick your preferred timeline option (A = faster, requires parallel work; B = conservative).
3) If OK, we'll schedule a 30-min MAP kickoff next week to lock owners and dates.

Attachments: ZEN-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (MAP table + responsibilities)
Related links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cZENMAP, HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Thanks \u0014 happy to iterate the draft.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference \u0014 production-first inference for teams

2) Timeline: we like Option A for business reasons, but procurement wants a slightly longer runway for contract review. Can we target a hybrid: begin POC in 6 weeks, but set security sign-off to 12 weeks total to allow legal review windows?
3) Procurement contact (procurement@zenwell.com) will need the SOC 2 evidence and the DPA redline. Can your security team share the SOC 2 scope and the standard DPA?
